title: EXP-099 - Hello World Part 6 Section 7: Image Library Discovery and Three FX_ Images (FX_Dumbbell, FX_Eggs, FX_Guitar) from assets/, Readback After Reopen
objective: Follow hello-world-pt6.md Section 7 (06:44-07:40), adapted to FX_ names: in the Web Designer close FX_OrdersChart, open the image library through the Edit menu Image entry and record it read-only (existing images, controls, fields). Image library discovery (read-only): open the Designer Edit menu once and record its entries; choose its Image entry once. Record the dialog title, every control and button (for example New, Import, Export, OK, Cancel, Help, and any removal control). Confirm the image library with OK once after the three entries and record the native response verbatim. If a Designer Save is then enabled, perform exactly one Designer Save and record its response; if Save stays disabled, record that no Save was needed. Never retry a Save.

Readback (read-only): open Edit > Image once more and verify FX_Dumbbell, FX_Eggs and FX_Guitar are listed with their previews (screenshot each entry selected by a view click, comparing the preview with the asset as seen in EXP-063-R2: dumbbell = golden retriever puppy, eggs = small grey-faced figure, guitar = sitting shiba). Record any stored file name, size or format shown. Leave the dialog with Cancel once and verify no prompt and a clean Designer.

Capture screenshots of the Designer gate, the Edit menu, the image library before any change (with its list), each new-image form before and after filling, each upload control showing the chosen file, the library before OK, the OK and any Save response, and the readback of each image. notes: Proposed by the operator assistant after EXP-098; on 2026-10-15 the operator approved using and committing the assets/ images (commit 704f7af) for the Section 7 image import.
